---
title: "manhattan plot"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrastr)
library(dplyr)
```

GWAS fabae BLINK

```{r}

# Load data
gwas <- read.csv(
  "../../../../../results_with_hedin/GWAS outpout/fabae/GAPIT.Association.GWAS_Results.BLINK.emmean(Kansas).csv"
)

gwas$P.value[gwas$P.value == 0] <- 1e-300
gwas <- na.omit(gwas)

gwas$Chr <- as.factor(gwas$Chr)
gwas$logP <- -log10(gwas$P.value)

# Compute cumulative chromosome positions
chr_sizes <- gwas %>%
  group_by(Chr) %>%
  summarise(chr_len = max(Pos)) %>%
  mutate(offset = lag(cumsum(chr_len), default = 0))

gwas <- left_join(gwas, chr_sizes, by = "Chr")
gwas$BPcum <- gwas$Pos + gwas$offset

# Chromosome centers for x-axis labels
axisdf <- gwas %>%
  group_by(Chr) %>%
  summarise(center = (min(BPcum) + max(BPcum))/2)

axisdf$label <- c("chr1S","chr1L","chr2","chr3","chr4","chr5","chr6")

# Plot
p <- ggplot(gwas,
            aes(BPcum, logP,
                colour = factor(as.numeric(Chr) %% 2))) +

  geom_point_rast(size = 0.6, dpi = 600) +

  scale_colour_manual(values = c("grey70", "grey40")) +

  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(5e-8),
             colour = "grey50") +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = axisdf$center,
    labels = axisdf$label
  ) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = expression(-log[10](italic(P))),
    title = "Manhattan Plot A. fabae – BLINK (Kansas)"
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, -log10(5e-16))) +

  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.border = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(
  "Manhattan_BLINK_fabae.pdf",
  p,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  device = cairo_pdf
)
```
